verdict.rationale: The gateway documents a unified API and OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints that reach multiple providers through one interface. The AI Gateway docs also show a tool-calling agent example (tools: { getWeather: tool(...) }) running against a gateway-routed model. Consistent tool and function-call schema normalization across providers is only implied by the unified-API claims, never documented explicitly. missing for 10: explicit documentation that tool/function-call schemas are normalized across providers, per-provider tool-calling support matrix, streaming tool-call details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can make tool and function calls across different providers with a consistent schema

citations.quote: AI Gateway provides OpenAI Chat Completions API endpoints, letting you use multiple AI providers through a familiar interface.
The AI Gateway's unified API provides flexibility, allowing you to switch between different AI models and providers without rewriting parts of your application.
